description.en: Guidelines for preventing AI hallucinations when using the corpus, including clear boundaries, uncertainty markers, and forbidden claims
description.zh: 防止AI在使用语料库时产生幻觉的指导原则，包括明确界限、不确定性标记和禁止声明

criteria: 直接来自Musk的推文、采访、演讲的引语
有明确来源和日期的公开声明
经核实的一级来源内容
criteria_en: Direct quotes from Musk's tweets, interviews, speeches
Public statements with clear sources and dates

criteria: 基于多个声明的合理推断
从行为模式推导的可能观点
行业分析师的解读（非Musk本人声明）
criteria_en: Reasonable inferences based on multiple statements
Possible viewpoints derived from behavioral patterns
Industry analyst interpretations (not Musk's own statements)

criteria: AI生成的'Musk可能会说'的内容
未经证实的传闻或猜测
其他人对Musk观点的解释（除非明确标注）
criteria_en: Others' interpretations of Musk's views (unless clearly labeled)

fact_boundary_definitions.example: We need to make life multiplanetary.
fact_boundary_definitions.handling: 可引用，需标注来源 / Quotable with source attribution

fact_boundary_definitions.example: Musk believes humans should colonize Mars.
fact_boundary_definitions.handling: 使用'Musk has stated...' / Use 'Musk has stated...'

fact_boundary_definitions.example: Musk likely supports space exploration funding.
fact_boundary_definitions.handling: 使用'Musk has suggested...' / Use 'Musk has suggested...'

fact_boundary_definitions.example: Musk probably thinks AI is dangerous.
fact_boundary_definitions.handling: 需验证或避免使用 / Verify or avoid using

fact_boundary_definitions.example: Musk said he will buy Google.
fact_boundary_definitions.handling: 禁止，除非有真实来源 / Forbidden unless real source exists

en: Company and project status at time of statement
zh: 声明的时间和地点
声明的受众（投资者、媒体、公众）
声明时的公司和项目状态
相关的市场或政治环境

en: Outdated information presented as current position
zh: 断章取义导致误解
过时信息被当作当前立场
玩笑话被当作严肃声明
特定场合的夸张表述被普遍化

certainty_levels.usage: 有直接引语来源 / Has direct quote source
certainty_levels.example: Musk said, 'We will land on Mars.'

certainty_levels.usage: 多次声明支持 / Multiple statements support
certainty_levels.example: Musk has indicated support for Mars colonization.

certainty_levels.usage: 间接暗示或单次提及 / Indirect hint or single mention
certainty_levels.example: Musk has suggested that AI safety is important.

certainty_levels.en_marker: Musk appears to... / It seems Musk...
certainty_levels.usage: 基于行为推断 / Based on behavior inference
certainty_levels.example: Musk appears to favor vertical integration.
It is unclear whether Musk supports this policy.

zh: Musk目前认为...
截至[日期]，Musk表示...
Musk当前的立场是...
在[年份]，Musk表示...
Musk此前认为...
当时，Musk说...

en: Musk has since changed his position...
zh: Musk此后改变了立场...
Musk后来澄清...
Musk随后表示...

en: This position may no longer be current.
As of [date], this was Musk's view.
zh: [已过期: 2024] Musk表示...
这一立场可能已不再适用。
截至[日期]，这是Musk的观点。

en: Musk promised [specific investment return/stock target] - unless from formal investor communication
Musk guaranteed [company won't fail/will definitely succeed] - unless direct quote
Musk said he will personally invest [specific amount] - unless SEC filing or public statement
zh: Musk承诺[具体投资回报/股价目标] - 除非来自正式投资者沟通
Musk保证[公司不会破产/一定会成功] - 除非直接引语
Musk说他会个人投资[具体金额] - 除非SEC备案或公开声明

en: Musk said he will [run for president/enter politics] - no public record
Musk revealed his [private medical information/family details] - unless he disclosed publicly
Musk admitted [mistakes/failures he never admitted] - requires direct quote
zh: Musk说他将[竞选总统/进入政界] - 无公开记录
Musk透露了他的[私人医疗信息/家庭细节] - 除非他本人公开
Musk承认[从未承认过的错误/失败] - 需直接引语

en: Musk announced [unconfirmed merger/acquisition] - requires official press release
Musk said [product is cancelled/definite release date] - requires official confirmation
Musk promised [specific delivery timeline] - requires direct quote and labeled as promise
zh: Musk宣布[未经证实的合并/收购] - 需官方新闻稿
Musk说[某产品已取消/已确定发布日期] - 需官方确认
Musk承诺[具体交付时间表] - 需直接引语并标注为承诺

en: Musk said [company won't face regulatory issues] - unless formal statement
Musk admitted [illegal activity] - absolutely forbidden unless court record
Musk guaranteed [will/won't take legal action] - requires lawyer confirmation
zh: Musk说[公司不会面临监管问题] - 除非正式声明
Musk承认[违法行为] - 绝对禁止，除非法庭记录
Musk保证[会/不会采取法律行动] - 需律师确认

high_risk_types.verification: SEC备案或官方投资者沟通

en: Use of obvious memes or internet slang
zh: 夸张到不合理的程度
使用明显的梗或网络用语
上下文表明是玩笑（如愚人节）
后续澄清'只是开玩笑'

handling.en: Clearly label as satire/joke. Do not provide literal interpretation.
handling.zh: 明确标注为讽刺/玩笑。不提供字面解释。

satire_detection.example: Musk jokingly tweeted that he would buy [company], later clarifying it was not serious.

step_1_source_verification: 确认来源是否为一级来源
step_2_content_verification: 查找原始引语的完整上下文
step_3_cross_verification: 查找至少一个独立来源确认
检查专业事实核查网站

en: Mention if there were subsequent changes
zh: 始终标注声明日期
提及是否有后续变化
区分'当时'与'现在'

historical_examples.statement: Tesla will reach FSD by end of year

rapidly_changing_2025_2026.handling: 标注具体日期，定期更新
标注版本号，追踪更新日志

en: Flag entries that may need updating
zh: 设置定期复查提醒（每月/每季度）
建立'最后验证日期'字段
标记可能需要更新的条目

standard_disclaimers.disclaimer: Not financial advice. Past performance does not guarantee future results.
Forward-looking statements subject to risks and uncertainties.
Timelines are aspirational and subject to change.
Personal opinion, not representative of any company.
Information current as of [date], subject to rapid change.

must_add: 涉及股票或投资建议的内容

templates.name: 一般性免责声明 / General Disclaimer
templates.zh: 本内容基于公开信息整理，不构成任何投资或行动建议。信息可能随时间变化。
templates.en: This content is based on publicly available information and does not constitute investment or action advice. Information may change over time.

templates.name: 时效性免责声明 / Timeliness Disclaimer
templates.zh: 本信息截至[日期]准确。鉴于情况的快速发展，建议核实最新信息。
templates.en: This information is accurate as of [date]. Given rapid developments, please verify the latest information.

templates.name: 预测性声明免责声明 / Forward-Looking Disclaimer
templates.zh: 本内容包含前瞻性声明，实际结果可能与预期有重大差异。
templates.en: This content contains forward-looking statements. Actual results may differ materially from expectations.

source_verification.zh: 是否有明确的一级来源？
来源是否可访问和验证？

content_boundaries.zh: 这是直接引语还是推断？
content_boundaries.en: Is this direct quote or inference?

content_boundaries.zh: 是否混淆了过去和现在？
是否保留了必要的语境？

forbidden_claims_check.zh: 是否涉及禁止的财务声明？
是否涉及禁止的个人声明？
是否涉及禁止的公司决策声明？

accuracy_verification.zh: 能否找到来源支持每个声明？
accuracy_verification.en: Can source be found for each claim?

accuracy_verification.zh: 是否有任何声明听起来'太好/太糟而不真实'？
accuracy_verification.en: Any claim sound 'too good/bad to be true'?

accuracy_verification.zh: 是否使用了适当的确定性标记？

temporal_verification.zh: 是否区分了过去和现在？
快速变化的主题是否标注了日期？

disclaimer_check.zh: 是否需要添加免责声明？
是否标注了不确定性级别？

common_issues.solution: 列出所有相关声明及其日期，说明立场变化的时间线，标注最新立场（如果有）

common_issues.zh: 如何处理被删除的推文？
common_issues.solution: 使用Wayback Machine等存档服务，引用存档链接，说明推文已被删除

common_issues.zh: 如何处理讽刺被误解的情况？
common_issues.solution: 明确标注为讽刺或玩笑，提供上下文说明为什么是讽刺，引用后续澄清（如果有）

common_issues.zh: 如何处理2025-2026快速变化的主题？
common_issues.en: How to handle 2025-2026 rapidly changing topics?
common_issues.solution: 添加'最后验证日期'字段，设置定期复查提醒，使用'进行中/Ongoing'标记
